notes.title: QUICK-DRAW MODE UPDATE
notes.content:
[u][b]Main Features[/b][/u]
-Overhauled the Quick-Draw mode.  It now includes 30 levels total split into 5 categories of gameplay.

[u][b]Minor Tweaks[/b][/u]
-Fix mags sticking to guns when being ejected.
-Worked on menu issues causing pointer to lose functionality
-Added to the settings menu a height calibration
-Added some new targets and tweaked some old targets
-Tweaked the pistol holsters to grab the gun from larger distance

[u][b]Next Update[/b][/u]
-Next update will be an overhaul of the Move 'n Shoot mode

As always please contact me with [b]issues[/b] or [b]ideas[/b] at p1441vr@gmail.com 
Thanks and happy shooting

notes.title: Small Update: Player Settings, Scoring, Target Fix
notes.content:
-Added position options for storing Rifle mags and degrees / speed settings for turning
-Reworked the Move 'n' Shoot scoring system *will need to reset scoring in game from settings menu*
-Fixed a few target hit boxes that weren't registering shots

notes.title: Small Patch Update 1/15/22
notes.content:
*Added a few player settings options. 
  Players can choose their movement hand and their shooting hand separately.
  Players can make some adjustments to turning degrees / speed
 
*Adjusted the zone for racking the slide slightly larger to prevent missing the slide and grabbing gun as a 
support hold (may need further adjusting)

*Fixed some Left handed body inventory bugs spawning mags with wrong rotation or not at all.
